episode_summary: In this episode, Ben Lalez discusses the concept of 'separation season' and how agents can leverage the last quarter of the year to set themselves apart. He emphasizes the importance of sticking to fundamentals, analyzing past successes, and maintaining consistent actions even when immediate results aren't visible. The episode provides actionable insights for agents and team leaders looking to maintain momentum and prepare for future success.
